facts.fact: Three van routes run six days a week; six employees, paid weekly
The owner, Gloria Rhee, has filed an election of exclusion and is not on the payroll register
The route log lists every route day with its driver and anyone riding along; pay weeks run Monday to Sunday
On 2026-07-20, after the audit period ended, dispatcher Lena Ortiz left with the AR-2 van and came back at noon
Weekly gross pay per employee sums to the register's wages_paid for every employee

confirmations.question: Gloria Rhee (business-description.md): please send a copy of the owner's election of exclusion that was in force for the audit period 2025-07-07 to 2026-07-05, since the first pass leaves her pay out of payroll on that basis.

Irene Voss (payroll-register.csv): please confirm that Irene Voss's duties were confined to bookkeeping in the office for the whole audit period, and that she never rode on a delivery route. The route log shows no ride-alongs for her.

open_items.proposal: Use the route log, not the application's note, for the ride-along weeks.
open_items.why: The application says the dispatchers work the phones and that Lena 'rides along about two days a week ... at most two fifths of her time'. route-log.csv records 60 ride-along days for Lena Ortiz and 2 for Paul Haskins in the audit period, so the note understates Paul's road time and does not match Lena's pattern. The records decide (HP-7).
open_items.employer_question: Application APP-AC-0529 note: please explain the statement that the dispatchers work the phones, when route-log.csv records Paul Haskins (AC-E05) as a ride-along on 2 route days and Lena Ortiz (AC-E04) on 60 route days.
